evidence.claim: ENUMERATED TARGET 5 - do the sync scripts apply a transform? NO content transform in either direction (all four use Copy-Item, a byte copy), but the directions are ASYMMETRIC in EOL awareness. sync-from-live.ps1 classifies with an EOL-normalised hash and skips EOL-ONLY pairs; the three repo->live scripts have no such guard. core.autocrlf system='true'; .gitattributes covers only *.sh eol=lf and *.ps1 eol=crlf (no *.md, no *.py). That is the mechanism behind the 413 EOL-ONLY pairs. sync-skills.ps1 does Remove-Item -Recurse -Force on the live skill dir and THEN recopies.
